mapper.select: select TBC.config_id as configId, /*配置代码*/ TBC.table_id as tableId, /*记账场景(会计事件编码)*/ TBC.subject_nature as subjectNature, /*发生额科目性质*/ TBC.vat_type as vatType, /*增值税类型*/ TBC.tax_p_type as taxPType, /*确认类型*/ TBC.income_source as incomeSource, /*发生场景*/ TBC.in_out as inOut, /*增项/减项*/ TBC.calc_type as calcType, /*计算方式*/ TBC.cd_flag as cdFlag, /*发生科目借贷方向*/ TBC.calc_scale as calcScale, /*占比方式*/ TBC.calc_snature as calcSnature, /*占比科目科目性质*/ TBC.calc_base as calcBase, /*占比基数*/ TBC.is_carrt as isCarrt, /*金额计入方式*/ TBC.int_repay_handle as intRepayHandle /*处理条件*/ from TAX_BOK_CONFIG TBC where TBC.config_id = #{configId}
select NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(config_id，-3， 3))), 0) from TAX_BOK_CONFIG where config_id like CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
